intro: Slovenian culture is known for poets, an imaginative architect, cheerful folk traditions and sausages.

chapters.title: Poets and architects
text: France Prešeren is the national poet; Prešeren Day, 8 February, the anniversary of his death, is a cultural holiday. Architect Jože Plečnik reshaped Ljubljana with bridges, markets and parks, now a World Heritage Site.

chapters.title: Traditions and food
text: At the Kurentovanje carnival in Ptuj, people dress as kurents, shaggy sheepskin figures who chase away winter. Potica, a rolled nut cake, and Carniolan sausage are favourites.

keyTerms.meaning: A shaggy carnival figure from Slovenian folklore.
